The implementation record is strongest where Putin wanted coercive capacity, not where he wanted open governance or durable accountability.","evidence":[{"title":"Putin’s foreign-policy concept became an official doctrine","publisher":"Kremlin","date":"Mar. 31, 2023","url":"https://www.kremlin.ru/acts/bank/49090/print","summary":"The doctrine operationalized his program at the level of state policy, explicitly setting priorities around strategic stability, arms control, conflict prevention, and nuclear-risk reduction. This is a concrete implementation mechanism, not just rhetoric.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.10","7B.7"]},{"title":"Russia raises treason penalties after the ICC warrant","publisher":"Reuters","date":"Apr. 18, 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russian-parliament-votes-to-introduce-life-sentences-for-treason-3058140","summary":"The Duma’s harsher treason and sabotage penalties show how the regime translated security priorities into legal enforcement. This is one of the clearest examples of program-to-implementation translation in 2023.","question_ids":["8B.2","1B.1","1B.7"]},{"title":"Putin says warheads were delivered to Belarus","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"Jun. 16, 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/putin-says-russia-positions-nuclear-bombs-in-belarus-as-warning-to-west-3107500","summary":"This is the clearest operational follow-through on the Belarus deployment: Putin publicly confirmed delivery and linked it to deterrence of strategic defeat.","question_ids":["8B.2","1B.1","1B.7"]},{"title":"Russia’s defense budget rises to a record share","publisher":"Reuters","date":"Sept. 29, 2023","url":"https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russias-2024-defense-spending-rise-record-share-budget-2023-09-29/","summary":"Defense spending at roughly a third of the budget shows that the regime’s strategic direction was translated into fiscal priorities. It shows program translation into elite management and enforcement of loyalty.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.6","7B.9"]},{"title":"Putin orders rescue efforts after the Kakhovka dam breach","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"Jun. 7, 2023","url":"https://theprint.in/world/putin-accuses-ukraine-of-destroying-the-kakhovka-dam-at-behest-of-west/1617195/","summary":"This is a limited operational response: emergency aid was ordered for the flooded area. It is real implementation, though paired with blame-shifting rather than a broader protection plan.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.8","7B.10"]},{"title":"Government expands free medical care and child benefits","publisher":"Government of the Russian Federation","date":"Jan. 9, 2023","url":"https://government.ru/en/news/47503/","summary":"This is the strongest narrow counterexample: Putin’s government did translate part of its domestic agenda into rule-based welfare delivery through formal administrative channels.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.10"]},{"title":"Social Fund standardizes child payments","publisher":"Social Fund of Russia","date":"Jan. 25, 2023","url":"https://sfr.gov.ru/en/press_center/~2023/01/25/250437","summary":"Child payments were centralized onto a fixed delivery schedule, showing an actual administrative implementation mechanism rather than ad hoc discretion.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.9","7B.10"]},{"title":"Nabiullina warns on deficits and inflation","publisher":"Reuters","date":"Feb. 10, 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/russian-central-bank-holds-key-rate-at-75-gives-hawkish-signal-3000569","summary":"This shows technocratic policy still had room to constrain the leadership on monetary issues, a partial counterexample to pure personalization.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.9"]},{"title":"Nabiullina resists arbitrary seizure of foreign bank units","publisher":"Reuters","date":"Apr. 28, 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/russia-should-not-take-temporary-control-of-foreign-banks-units-central-bank-3067714","summary":"This is a narrow but real example of a professional official pushing back against the most politicized impulses of the wartime state.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.9"]}]}
